description: T2: Complex combinational Trojan in 8-bit ALU. Uses a wider and deeper logic cone for its trigger, involving multi-stage conditions from operands, opcode, and internal carry.
taxonomy: Digital, combinationally triggered, complex-condition Hardware Trojan

trigger.readable: A[3:0]==0xA AND B[3:0]==0x5 AND OP==ADD AND results in carry out AND A[7]==1 AND B[7]==0
trigger.note: Trigger logic is deeper than T1, involving a chain of LUTs and evaluating an intermediate computed signal (alu_carry).

payload.action: Force Y to 0xFF, force overflow to 1
payload.note: A larger payload affecting multiple output bits.

structural_hints.expected_trigger_structure: Multi-level LUT chain converging on t2_trigger. Paths from A, B, OP, and internal carry logic.
structural_hints.expected_payload_structure: MUXes or override logic on all Y bits and the overflow bit.
